payload.title: File:Herugavialis cairensis (paleoart by Karim Zanaty).png
payload.artist_html: P. M. J. Burke, S. N. F. Spiekman, B. S. Salem, S. Saber, H. M. Sallam & P. D. Mannion
payload.credit_html: "Cranial anatomy of the Middle Eocene Egyptian crocodylian Herugavialis cairensis provides new insights into gavialoid diversity in the Mediterranean region"
payload.description_html: Life reconstruction of Herugavialis cairensis in left lateral view. Herugavialis is depicted with The Great Sphinx and pyramids of Giza in the background, the construction of which occurred long after the extinction of Herugavialis. Artwork by Karim Zanaty.
